fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on South Florida tourism and the local economy, criticism of gambling and race-track influence (including Hialeah), discussion of grand jury matters and Miami municipal politics, and local civic concerns such as traffic enforcement and policing. Regular columns and features cover nightlife and entertainment in Miami and Miami Beach, along with advertisements and promotional material for clubs, restaurants, and racing-related tip services.
